description.value: A creek-side RV park in a valley 5 minutes south of Nelson, with showers and flush toilets on-site and easy access to mountain biking, hiking, and the west arm of Kootenay Lake. No sani-dump on-site; road surface not specified but location implies paved access.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Cool Waters RV Park is located south of Nelson BC with amenities including wireless internet, electrical and water service, showers, and toilets. It explicitly notes no septic or sani-dump on-site. OSM provides minimal tags (name and tourism=caravan_site) with no address or phone. The site appears active (copyright 2025). The website mentions proximity to mountain bike trails, making it relevant to cycling tourism, though it is primarily an RV park and does not explicitly mention tent or hiker/biker camping.
concerns: No address or phone available from OSM or website
